So we buy it ! I can't move into one of the apartments yet cuz renos but I move my things into the garage, buy a used 19' trailer camper and move to another friends 42 acre private camp ground, no biggy, it's May & I have until November bfr it gets too cold.

I start getting busy with quotes from contractors, urbanism at city hall, shit gets complicated with new bylaws for escape routes on 2nd floor. Scandal at city hall involving the urbanism department, they reshuffle the staff twice in 3 months, everything stalls for the permits... risks you take in real estate.

It's now septembre, buddy hires a 20 year old trade school drop out (I checked, I was teaching there before) because he's impatient to get things moving, the dude lies about hours, screws up simple tasks & doesn't follow code, does dangerous things, etc. At the bank we negotiated with me as resident owner, so I'm liable for the legal warranty if we sell, I wasn't having any of it tensions start to rise with buddy. I get 2 friends to come help doing cash work for a week (pros) and we haul ass to catch up & save on contractors. Buddy is jealous of my success & pissed about his failed move. By then our first block of financing was almost out so I paid my buddies myself & was waiting on the next block to reimburse myself. Bfr the bank gives more money we need 60% done... we're not there yet. So I pay a plumber & electrician myself to get us to 60%. By then it was clear I wasn't moving in before winter, a common friend had taken my old apartment so we became roomies. He was a drywall & mud guy so even better ! Until he got layed off for winter & became involved in our project.

By then my partner was beginning to act differently, he was changing. He began managing the project behind my back and getting work done on all but my apartment. Suddenly he began talking about doing a flip & selling... he started dating an interior designer & wanted to hire her. NO FUCKING WAY ! It's rental property, you paint white & put in anything but fancy cabinets & trims. Fucking guy was starting to toy with me.

I don't say a word, we have our meeting & argue about him not following our agreement, playing behind my back & redirecting work from my place. He tries to paint a picture of me not doing enough, not managing things, saying you either put in money or time in a project like that... as if I was doing neither. I was working 50 hours a week at my new job, running materials at night & spending Saturdays there. He was a federal employee working from home 35hrs a week. I fuck off to my camper (March by now) & get drunk and stoned to forget everything going on in town.

Fuck ! I'm an hour away, can't drive cuz drunk, what do I do ? I call mom ! "Mom ! Shits going down, can you just go grab my stuff to safeguard it, my roomy will help with my matress & whatever".
